profile.headline:
Google Developer Expert  ⚡  Staff Software Engineer 
🏗️ Building product UI, AI Workflows and shared infrastructure at SaaS companies
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer working on frontend architecture, design systems, and product UI at SaaS companies. I ship customer-facing features — Billing workflows, timesheets, localization systems — while leading cross-team initiatives around shared component libraries, performance, and code quality. Increasingly invested in AI-assisted engineering workflows, including a Claude Code plugin ecosystem for Angular development at Aiwyn.
 
Outside of work, I build open-source tools that solve problems I run into myself. SpecKit Companion adds a visual layer for spec-driven development across AI coding agents. ngx-dev-toolbar gives Angular apps a runtime developer toolbar for feature flags, locale switching, network mocking, and user-persona presets.
 
I'm a Google Developer Expert in Angular and write for ng-conf and other Medium publications. I've spoken at DevFest Guadalajara, DevFest Xalapa, Angular Air, and the Angular Community Meetup, which I formerly co-organized.
 
If you're working on product UI, design systems, developer tooling, or AI-assisted engineering workflows — those are the conversations I find most interesting.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description: Skills: Angular · TypeScript · TanStack Query · Frontend Architecture · Design Systems · Anthropic Claude · Generative AI for Web Developers · Technical Leadership

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Establish direction and elevate development practices by using Agile methodologies to drive improvement, serving as Technical Lead. Strengthen team operations and knowledge sharing by setting up new project management frameworks and producing comprehensive technical documentation. Demonstrate exceptional technical leadership when conducting cohesive engineering presentations and facilitating mentorship programs. 

Select Achievements
♦	Architected and led development of enterprise design system and component library using Storybook, which standardized UI patterns, improved developer velocity, and enhanced user experiences across interfaces. 
♦	Directed enterprise Angular modernization initiative with major performance optimizations that reduced initial
load times by 50% while introducing standard documentation and best practices for all development teams.
♦	Managed Tiger Team to improve multi-language support and eliminate localization issues through full-stack development of translations system using Nx, Angular, PostgreSQL, NestJS, and AWS Translation Services.
♦	Significantly improved code quality by implementing frontend tooling that included Storybook for component
documentation, TanStack Query for state management, and Cypress Component Testing. 
♦	Awarded engineering department challenge coin in recognition of exemplary contributions and leadership.
positions.insights: Skills: NestJS · User Interface Design · Angular · Nx · StoryBook · Anguar · Performance Tuning · Component Documentation

positions.title: Staff UI Engineer
positions.description:
Unified team focus on creating high-quality software by developing clear coding guidelines, rules, video tutorials, and live-coding sessions. Created style guide for UI team to standardize component development, styling, use of Angular, and testing. Hosted meetings alongside UI leaders to define architecture and strategic plans for product parts. Improved the Developer Experience (DevX) by establishing patterns on how to develop well-tested components and adding tools to prevent boilerplate code.

Select Achievements
♦	Implemented API service that standardized handling of API requests and responses; developed abstraction on top of NgRx Entity to supply additional selectors and state management for entities returned from API calls.
♦	Optimized UI CI/CD pipelines by integrating DeploySentinel to improve troubleshooting and analysis for flaky 
Cypress tests, and lower runtime by over 20% with parallel runs and elimination of redundant activities.
♦	Led Storybook and Cypress adoption to document component and UI modules, and reuse for integration tests.
♦	Improved handling of UI metadata by using NestJS/Node to develop API that included a logging service for Kibana integration, decorators and services to integrate with Kafka, and repository service to map/validate data.
♦	Guided UI intern in developing static site generator with GatsbyJS, React, and Typescript, resulting in a designated style guide website for UI team that could easily be maintained by UX or UI engineers.
positions.insights: Skills: User Interface Design · Web Development · Angular · Component Library · Application Architecture Design · Cypress.io · Front-End Development · StoryBook

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Ensured the development team achieved goals by delegating assignments and overseeing daily activities. Supported career development for junior-level developers through ongoing training and mentorship. Used diverse backend to increase operational efficiency for dealer by developing Windows 8 application, providing innovative solutions and information. 
Select Achievements
♦	Executed major process improvements using Agile methodology to ensure reliable, scalable software delivery. 
♦	Received Innovation Award for successfully developing AngularJs/Angular 2 component pattern library. 
♦	Increased effectiveness of UI and .NET RESTful API for backend by creating customer-facing web applications.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · User Interface Design · GraphQL · .NET Core · Angular Material · .NET

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated with engineering leadership and business stakeholders to transform critical business needs into actionable engineering requirements for effective solutions. Strengthened expertise with Agile software development processes.
 
Select Achievements
♦	Secured abstraction for grid’s individual components using JavaScript functional inheritance to create widget.
♦	Helped improve alignment and clarity across teams to reach demanding project outcomes and timelines.
positions.insights: Skills: User Interface Design · jQuery Mobile · ASP.NET MVC

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and supported new software applications. Spearheaded assigned projects and worked with support staff to create and implement the software product. 
Key Accomplishments:
•	Analyzed data received from electronics equipment such as semaphores, electronic doors, PLC, alarms, and the warehouse data system to develop an architecture that accurately controlled robots mission assignment. 
•	Reviewed, interpreted, and adhered to specification documentation to engineer an application that utilized C# to control Laser Guided Vehicles, which were used to organize warehouses by transporting products between locations.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Developed, tested, and installed software applications, following up with end-users as needed. Conducted design and requirement meetings with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders. Wrote functional and design documentation as needed. 
  Key Accomplishments:
•	Adhered to design proposals and teamed with senior-level software developers to accurately implement new software features and enhancements. 
•	Performed troubleshooting to correct software defects in the Software Quality Assurance Department.

positions.description: Executed Firmware Developer functions to accurately create applications that optimized communications between the company’s proprietary hardware.

projects.title: Central
projects.description: This a WPF project that implements PRISM with MEF as the IoC. This is an IDE with a modern UI where developers can run and centralize all their different apps.

projects.title: Angular Dev Toolbar
projects.description:
A powerful development toolbar for Angular applications that helps developers to interact with the application in a more efficient way.

Key features:
• Toggle feature flags in real-time
• Switch languages instantly
• Manage themes and user sessions
• Mock network requests
• Fully extensible for custom tools
